64:- `POST /v1/devices/{device_id}/sync/ack-batch`：一台设备对多个 **1:1** 会话的批量离线确认，整批在同一存储锁事务（一次持久化通知、与设备撤销共锁）内完成；路径 `device_id` 未知或已撤销 `409/field=device_id`。请求体须为对象且含非空数组 `items`：坏 JSON/体非对象 `400/request_body`，`items` 缺失/非数组/空 `400/items`；每项须为对象（非对象或 `session_id` 重复 `400/items[i]`），含非空字符串 `session_id`（缺失/空/非字符串 `400/items[i].session_id`）与非布尔非负整数 `cursor`（缺失/非整数/布尔/浮点/负数 `400/items[i].cursor`）。设备校验后按数组顺序逐项校验、首错全不写：会话未知（既非 1:1 亦非群组会话）`404/items[i].session_id`；群会话或该设备非此 1:1 会话接收方 `409/items[i].session_id`；cursor 低于该会话已存游标（无记录为 0）或高于该会话最大 sequence `409/items[i].cursor`。成功体键序 `device_id`、`results`；`results` 同输入顺序，每项键序 `session_id`、`cursor`、`updated_at`。各项语义同单会话 sync/ack 的 1:1 路径：前进项把其 `(old, cursor]` 消息在 `delivery` 中逐条置 acked 且 `ack_sequence=sequence`（无记录则建），重试 `attempts` 与 attempt 去重集合不变，推进统一游标 `message_sync_cursors`；全部前进项共用一个 UTC ISO-8601（带 `+00:00`）时间，等值项不写、游标 0 的等值项 `updated_at` 取该会话 `created_at`。任一项前进即整批 `201`，全部等值 `200`。整批单次提交、`commit_seq` 至多加 1；落盘失败 `503/field=data_file` 并把全部游标、`delivery`、`updated_at` 与代次一并回滚。`version=1` 无新顶层键、无 CLI 子命令，重启完整恢复。
65:- `GET /v1/devices/{device_id}/inbox`：设备离线收件箱，聚合该设备作为接收方的全部 **1:1** 会话中尚未确认的消息（群组会话不纳入，同用户其他设备的会话不出现）。仅允许单值查询参数 `limit`，默认 100，须为无符号十进制整数 1..100，否则（含重复参数、空值、非十进制、越界）`400/field=limit`；设备未知或已撤销 `409/field=device_id`；错误体键序 `message`、`field`。成功 `200`，体键序 `device_id`、`messages`、`has_more`；`messages` 至多 `limit` 项，每项键序 `session_id`、`sender_device_id`、`message_id`、`sequence`、`nonce`、`ciphertext`、`created_at`，仅含会话 `recipient_device_id` 等于目标且 `delivery` 记录缺失或 `acked=false` 的消息，按 `(session.created_at, session_id 码点序, sequence)` 升序；`has_more` 表示锁内快照在本页之后尚有余项。查询与消息提交、确认、设备撤销共享存储同一把锁线性化，但为纯只读：不落盘、不增 `commit_seq`、不改任何游标或 `attempts`，状态未变则响应逐字节相同。确认仍沿用现有 `sync/ack` 与 `sync/ack-batch`（按各会话最高 sequence 推进游标并逐条置 acked），确认后的消息不再出现于收件箱。无新状态键、无 CLI 子命令，重启后由 `messages` 与 `delivery` 段完整重建同一视图。其余 README 入口不变。
66:- `GET /v1/devices/{device_id}/inbox/wait`：设备离线收件箱的长轮询版本，无请求体。非空体 `400/field=request_body`；仅允许单值查询参数 `limit`、`timeout_ms`，出现任何其他参数（含裸 `?foo`）`400/field=query`（仅末尾空 `?` 不算参数）；`limit` 默认 100，须为 ASCII 十进制整数 1..100（仅数字、无符号/空白/小数点/进制前缀，前导零允许），重复、空值、非十进制或越界 `400/field=limit`；`timeout_ms` 默认 30000，须为 ASCII 十进制整数 0..30000，同样的严格校验、重复、空值或非法 `400/field=timeout_ms`；校验顺序固定为请求体、其他参数、`limit`、`timeout_ms`。错误体键序 `message`、`field`。路径设备未知或已撤销 `409/field=device_id`。锁内若已有未确认的 **1:1** 消息立即按现有 `inbox` 口径返回（成功体键序 `device_id`、`messages`、`has_more`，消息项七键顺序与聚合、排序规则同 `GET …/inbox`，按 `(session.created_at, session_id 码点序, sequence)` 升序取 `limit` 项，`has_more` 表示同一锁内快照尚有余项）；否则用单调时钟等待，直到有消息变为可收、设备被撤销或超时，等待期间不持存储锁、不阻塞消息提交/确认/撤销；每次被唤醒后都在锁内重检，且先判撤销再取消息；到达截止时刻再重检一次，确无消息才返回 `200` 且 `messages=[]`、`has_more=false`。接口为纯只读：不落盘、不增 `commit_seq`、不改任何游标、租约、`attempts` 或旁车；无新状态键、无 CLI 子命令，重启后行为与现有收件箱一致。其余 README 的 HTTP/CLI 入口不变且不属本题。
67:- `POST /v1/devices/{device_id}/inbox/retry-batch`：重试 **1:1** 收件箱投递，整批在同一存储锁事务（一次持久化通知、与设备撤销共锁）内完成。请求体须为对象且含非空字符串 `attempt_id` 与非空数组 `items`：坏 JSON/体非对象 `400/request_body`，`attempt_id` 缺失/空/非字符串 `400/attempt_id`，`items` 缺失/非数组/空 `400/items`；每项须为对象（非对象或 `(session_id, message_id)` 二元组重复 `400/items[i]`），含非空字符串 `session_id` 与 `message_id`（缺失/空/非字符串分别 `400/items[i].session_id`、`400/items[i].message_id`）。路径 `device_id` 未知或已撤销 `409/field=device_id`。设备校验后按数组顺序逐项预检、首错全不写：会话未知（既非 1:1 亦非群组会话）`404/items[i].session_id`；群会话或该设备非此 1:1 会话接收方 `409/items[i].session_id`；消息未知 `404/items[i].message_id`；消息已确认 `409/items[i].message_id`。锁内把同一个 `attempt_id` 加入各目标消息 `delivery` 记录的 attempt 去重集合（无记录则建）：集合已有该 id 视为重放、`attempts` 不计数，否则 `attempts` 加 1。成功体键序 `device_id`、`results`；`results` 同输入顺序，每项键序 `session_id`、`message_id`、`attempts`。任一项首次计入即整批 `201`；全部为重放则 `200` 且不落盘、不增 `commit_seq`。整批单次提交、`commit_seq` 至多加 1；落盘失败 `503/field=data_file` 并把全部 `delivery` 去重集合与 `attempts`、代次与双文件一并回滚。错误体键序 `message`、`field`。`version=1` 无新顶层键、无 CLI 子命令，重启完整恢复；其余 README 入口不变。
68:- `POST /v1/devices/{device_id}/inbox/claim`：为 **1:1** 收件箱补投加租约。请求体须为对象且含非空字符串 `lease_id` 与非布尔整数 `limit`（取值 1..100）：坏 JSON/体非对象 `400/request_body`，`lease_id` 缺失/空/非字符串 `400/lease_id`，`limit` 缺失/非整数/布尔/浮点/越界 `400/limit`。路径 `device_id` 未知或已撤销 `409/field=device_id`（在存储锁内判定，与撤销线性化）。锁内按收件箱既有顺序 `(session.created_at, session_id 码点序, sequence)`，选出至多 `limit` 条「尚未确认且无有效租约（无租约或租约已到期）」的消息，统一授予 30 秒租约：把同一个 `lease_id`、同一 `leased_until` 记到各消息 `delivery` 记录上（无记录则建）。非空领取返回 `201` 并占用该 `lease_id`；空集返回 `200`、`leased_until` 为 `null`，不建任何 `delivery` 记录、不落盘、不增 `commit_seq`，该 id 保持空闲。响应键序固定 `device_id`、`lease_id`、`leased_until`、`messages`；空集 `leased_until=null`，非空为领取时刻 +30 秒的 UTC ISO-8601（恒为 6 位微秒、`+00:00`）；`messages` 每项沿用收件箱七键顺序 `session_id`、`sender_device_id`、`message_id`、`sequence`、`nonce`、`ciphertext`、`created_at`。已占用 `lease_id` 以同设备同 `limit` 重放恒返回 `200` 及与首次逐字节相同的响应（即便消息此后被确认、租约已到期或设备已撤销，均为锁内优先判定）；同一 id 跨设备复用或改变 `limit` 返回 `409/field=lease_id`（该冲突优先于路径设备状态）。租约到期后消息可由新的 `lease_id` 再次领取（旧到期租约保留为历史但不再阻挡）；确认、领取、重试与设备撤销共用存储同一把锁线性化，失败不写任何租约。`version=1` 不新增顶层键：`delivery` 每项在原六键（`session_id`、`message_id`、`attempts`、`attempt_ids`、`acked`、`ack_sequence`）之后追加 `leases` 数组，旧文件缺该字段按空租约加载；数组元素键序为 `lease_id`、`limit`、`leased_until`，`lease_id`/`leased_until` 为非空字符串、`limit` 为 1..100 非布尔整数，同一记录内 `lease_id` 不重复，且同一 `lease_id` 在所有记录中必须绑定同一设备、同一 `limit` 与同一 `leased_until`；类型错误、同 id 跨设备或 `limit`/时间不一致一律拒绝启动且绝不覆盖原文件，序列化沿用 README 既有口径（UTF-8、`ensure_ascii=false`、紧凑 JSON，元素键序固定）。非空领取一次性提交、`commit_seq` 恰好加 1；落盘失败 `503/field=data_file`，内存、状态文件与旁车（含代次、inode）一并回滚。无新 CLI 子命令；既有收件箱查询、retry-batch、确认接口与 CLI 语义不变且不属本题。

"""Tests for the device offline inbox endpoint.

GET /v1/devices/{device_id}/inbox aggregates, read-only and under the store
lock, the unacknowledged messages of every 1:1 session the device is the
recipient of (group sessions and other devices' sessions never contribute),
ordered by (session.created_at, session_id, sequence).
"""
import json
import os
import shutil
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
from http.client import HTTPConnection

from e2ee_backend.models import Device, SignedPreKey
from e2ee_backend.persistence import attach_persistence
from e2ee_backend.service import DeviceService, ServiceError
from e2ee_backend.http_app import create_server


class InboxMixin:
    def _build(self) -> None:
        self.service = DeviceService()
        self.service.store.add_device(Device("u", "alice", "ik"))
        # bob holds three pre-keys so several distinct 1:1 sessions can be
        # addressed to him; bob2 is a second device of the same user.
        self.service.store.add_device(Device(
            "u", "bob", "ik",
            prekeys=[SignedPreKey("pk1", "pubk1"),
                     SignedPreKey("pk2", "pubk2"),
                     SignedPreKey("pk3", "pubk3")]))
        self.service.store.add_device(
            Device("u", "bob2", "ik", prekeys=[SignedPreKey("pkB", "pubkB")]))
        self.service.store.add_device(
            Device("u", "carol", "ik", prekeys=[SignedPreKey("pkC", "pubkC")]))
        # Two sessions addressed to bob.
        self.sid1 = self.service.store.create_session(
            "alice", "bob", "pk1", "ek1").session_id
        self.sid2 = self.service.store.create_session(
            "carol", "bob", "pk2", "ek2").session_id
        for sequence in range(1, 4):
            self.service.post_message({
                "session_id": self.sid1, "sender_device_id": "alice",
                "message_id": f"a{sequence}", "sequence": sequence,
                "nonce": f"na{sequence}", "ciphertext": "ct"})
        for sequence in range(1, 3):
            self.service.post_message({
                "session_id": self.sid2, "sender_device_id": "carol",
                "message_id": f"b{sequence}", "sequence": sequence,
                "nonce": f"nb{sequence}", "ciphertext": "ct"})
        # A session addressed to bob's other device bob2 (must not leak).
        self.sid_other = self.service.store.create_session(
            "alice", "bob2", "pkB", "ekB").session_id
        self.service.post_message({
            "session_id": self.sid_other, "sender_device_id": "alice",
            "message_id": "o1", "sequence": 1,
            "nonce": "no1", "ciphertext": "ct"})
        # A session bob initiated towards carol (bob is not its recipient).
        self.sid_out = self.service.store.create_session(

    def redelivery_job_recover_batch(
            self, device_id: str, items: List[Tuple[str, str]]
    ) -> Tuple[List[Dict[str, Any]], bool]:
        """Atomically recover many running redelivery jobs of one device.

        ``POST /v1/inbox-jobs/recover-batch``; *items* are ``(job_id,
        recovery_id)`` pairs already validated for shape and per-field
        uniqueness by the service. Under the one store lock — shared with
        leases, completions, acks and revocation — the device is resolved
        first (unknown/revoked -> :class:`RedeliveryJobError`
        ``device_unknown``/``device_inactive``, 409/device_id).

        Every item is then prechecked in array order with exactly the
        single-job ``recover`` rules (see :meth:`redelivery_job_recover`),
        the first failure raising :class:`RedeliveryJobRecoverBatchError`
        carrying that item's index — the batch writes nothing. An item
        whose *recovery_id* is already committed on its own job is a
        replay: it passes the precheck untouched (mirroring the single-job
        short-circuit) and is collected instead. After the precheck, a
        batch whose items are *all* replays returns the jobs' current views
        with ``any_new`` false and writes nothing; a batch mixing replays
        with fresh items raises ``recovery_replay`` at the first replayed
        index (409/items[i].recovery_id) — the earlier request was only
        partially applied, which the atomic batch cannot reproduce.

        Only when every item is fresh does the commit run, claiming in
        input order: each job re-leases up to
        :data:`REDELIVERY_JOB_DISPATCH_LIMIT` unacked, currently unleased
        inbox messages (messages leased by an earlier item of the same
        batch are already withheld from the next) under an ordinary
        :data:`INBOX_LEASE_SECONDS` lease named by its *recovery_id*, or
        ends ``succeeded`` with ``lease_id`` null on an empty selection —
        exactly the single-job state transitions. One persistence
        notification commits the whole batch (commit_seq + 1); a durable
        write failure rolls every job and lease back. Returns
        ``(results, any_new)`` with one ``job_id``/``state``/``lease_id``
        view per item, in input order.
        """
        with self._lock:
            device = self._find_device(device_id)
            if device is None:
                raise RedeliveryJobError(REDELIVERY_JOB_DEVICE_UNKNOWN)
            if device.revoked:
                raise RedeliveryJobError(REDELIVERY_JOB_DEVICE_INACTIVE)
            now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            jobs: List[RedeliveryJob] = []
            replay_indices: List[int] = []
            # Precheck in array order; only after every item passes (or is
            # a replay) is anything touched below.
            for index, (job_id, recovery_id) in enumerate(items):
                job = self._redelivery_jobs.get(job_id)
                if job is not None and job.device_id != device_id:
                    raise RedeliveryJobRecoverBatchError(
                        REDELIVERY_JOB_CONFLICT, index)
                if job is None:
                    raise RedeliveryJobRecoverBatchError(
                        REDELIVERY_JOB_NOT_FOUND, index)
                jobs.append(job)
                if any(record.recovery_id == recovery_id
                       for record in job.recoveries):
                    # An exact replay of this item's own recovery: it
                    # short-circuits every further check, as the
                    # single-job entry does.
                    replay_indices.append(index)
                    continue
                # The recovery_id shares one namespace with every job_id,
                # every job's recovery history and the ordinary inbox
                # lease ids (see the single-job recover).
                if any(other.job_id == recovery_id
                       for other in self._redelivery_jobs.values()):
                    raise RedeliveryJobRecoverBatchError(
                        REDELIVERY_JOB_RECOVERY_CONFLICT, index)
                if any(any(record.recovery_id == recovery_id
                           for record in other.recoveries)
                       for other in self._redelivery_jobs.values()
                       if other is not job):
                    raise RedeliveryJobRecoverBatchError(
                        REDELIVERY_JOB_RECOVERY_CONFLICT, index)
                if self._find_inbox_lease_locked(recovery_id) is not None:
                    raise RedeliveryJobRecoverBatchError(
                        REDELIVERY_JOB_RECOVERY_CONFLICT, index)
                if job.state != REDELIVERY_JOB_RUNNING:
                    raise RedeliveryJobRecoverBatchError(
                        REDELIVERY_JOB_RECOVERY_STATE, index)
                current_lease: Optional[MessageLease] = None
                for state in self._delivery.values():
                    for lease in state.leases:
                        if lease.lease_id == job.lease_id:
                            current_lease = lease
                            break
                    if current_lease is not None:
                        break
                if current_lease is not None \
                        and self._lease_is_active_locked(current_lease, now):
                    raise RedeliveryJobRecoverBatchError(
                        REDELIVERY_JOB_RECOVERY_LEASE_ACTIVE, index)
            if replay_indices:
                if len(replay_indices) == len(items):
                    # A full replay of a previously committed batch: the
                    # current views, in input order, and nothing written.
                    return [self.redelivery_job_view(job) for job in jobs], \
                        False
                # A partial replay can neither commit (the replayed items
                # would be re-applied) nor replay (the fresh items never
                # ran): the batch conflicts at its first replayed item.
                raise RedeliveryJobRecoverBatchError(
                    REDELIVERY_JOB_RECOVERY_REPLAY, replay_indices[0])
            leased_until = (now + timedelta(
                seconds=INBOX_LEASE_SECONDS)).isoformat(
                    timespec="microseconds")
            for job, (_job_id, recovery_id) in zip(jobs, items):
                picked: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
                for _, session_id, message in self._inbox_entries_locked(
                        device_id):
                    key = (session_id, message.message_id)
                    state = self._delivery.get(key)
                    if state is not None \
                            and self._has_active_lease_locked(state, now):
                        continue
                    picked.append(key)
                    if len(picked) >= REDELIVERY_JOB_DISPATCH_LIMIT:
                        break
                if picked:
                    # An ordinary inbox lease named by the recovery_id; a

        """Atomically recover many running redelivery jobs of one device.

        ``POST /v1/inbox-jobs/recover-batch``; *items* are ``(job_id,
        recovery_id)`` pairs already validated for shape and per-field
        uniqueness by the service. Under the one store lock — shared with
        leases, completions, acks and revocation — the device is resolved
        first (unknown/revoked -> :class:`RedeliveryJobError`
        ``device_unknown``/``device_inactive``, 409/device_id).

        Every item is then prechecked in array order with exactly the
        single-job ``recover`` rules (see :meth:`redelivery_job_recover`),
        the first failure raising :class:`RedeliveryJobRecoverBatchError`
        carrying that item's index — the batch writes nothing. An item
        whose *recovery_id* is already committed on its own job is a
        replay: it passes the precheck untouched (mirroring the single-job
        short-circuit) and is collected instead. After the precheck, a
        batch whose items are *all* replays returns the jobs' current views
        with ``any_new`` false and writes nothing; a batch mixing replays
        with fresh items raises ``recovery_replay`` at the first replayed
        index (409/items[i].recovery_id) — the earlier request was only
        partially applied, which the atomic batch cannot reproduce.

        Only when every item is fresh does the commit run, claiming in
        input order: each job re-leases up to
        :data:`REDELIVERY_JOB_DISPATCH_LIMIT` unacked, currently unleased
        inbox messages (messages leased by an earlier item of the same
        batch are already withheld from the next) under an ordinary
        :data:`INBOX_LEASE_SECONDS` lease named by its *recovery_id*, or
        ends ``succeeded`` with ``lease_id`` null on an empty selection —
        exactly the single-job state transitions. One persistence
        notification commits the whole batch (commit_seq + 1); a durable
        write failure rolls every job and lease back. Returns
        ``(results, any_new)`` with one ``job_id``/``state``/``lease_id``
        view per item, in input order.

            if device is None:

            if device.revoked:

            now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            jobs: List[RedeliveryJob] = []
            replay_indices: List[int] = []
            # Precheck in array order; only after every item passes (or is
            # a replay) is anything touched below.
            for index, (job_id, recovery_id) in enumerate(items):
                job = self._redelivery_jobs.get(job_id)
                if job is not None and job.device_id != device_id:

                        REDELIVERY_JOB_CONFLICT, index)
                if job is None:

                        REDELIVERY_JOB_NOT_FOUND, index)

            self, payload: object) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], int]:
        """Validate and atomically apply a batch of redelivery-job recovers.

        ``POST /v1/inbox-jobs/recover-batch``. The body must be a JSON
        object carrying a non-empty string ``device_id`` and a non-empty
        ``items`` array of objects, each with a non-empty string ``job_id``
        and ``recovery_id``, neither field repeating across items. Shape
        errors are reported, in order, as 400/field ``request_body``
        (bad/non-object body), ``device_id`` (missing/empty/non-string),
        ``items`` (missing/not-a-non-empty-array), ``items[i]`` (non-object
        element) or ``items[i].job_id`` / ``items[i].recovery_id`` for the
        offending field — a repeated value included.

        The device is then resolved (unknown/revoked -> 409/field
        ``device_id``) and every item is prechecked in array order under
        the single-job ``op=recover`` rules, the first error aborting the
        whole batch with nothing written and its field prefixed to
        ``items[i].``: an unknown job is 404/``items[i].job_id``, a job of
        another device or a non-recoverable state is
        409/``items[i].job_id``, a recovery_id colliding with another job,
        recovery or lease is 409/``items[i].recovery_id`` and a still-valid
        lease is 409/``items[i].lease_id``. A batch whose items all replay
        their own committed recoveries answers 200 and writes nothing; a
        partially replayed batch is 409/``items[i].recovery_id`` at the
        first replayed item. Otherwise every job is recovered in input
        order under one locked commit (201). On success the body is
        ``device_id`` then ``results``; results keep input order and each
        item is ``job_id``/``state``/``lease_id``.
        """
        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
            raise ServiceError("request body must be a JSON object",
                               "request_body")
        if "device_id" not in payload:
            raise ServiceError("missing required field: device_id",
                               "device_id")
        if not is_nonempty_string(payload["device_id"]):
            raise ServiceError(
                "field must be a non-empty string: device_id", "device_id")
        if "items" not in payload:
            raise ServiceError("missing required field: items", "items")
        raw_items = payload["items"]
        if not isinstance(raw_items, list) or not raw_items:
            raise ServiceError(
                "field must be a non-empty array: items", "items")

        items: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
        seen_job_ids: set = set()
        seen_recovery_ids: set = set()
        for index, element in enumerate(raw_items):
            item_field = f"items[{index}]"
            if not isinstance(element, dict):
                raise ServiceError(
                    f"array element must be an object: {item_field}",
                    item_field)
            job_field = f"{item_field}.job_id"
            if "job_id" not in element:
                raise ServiceError(
                    f"missing required field: {job_field}", job_field)
            if not is_nonempty_string(element["job_id"]):
                raise ServiceError(

任何矛盾拒启且绝不覆盖原文件。新写项固定五键键序，空 `recoveries` 写 `[]`（旧四键文档按空历史加载）；序列化沿用既有口径（UTF-8、`ensure_ascii=false`、紧凑无换行）。无新 CLI 子命令；其余 README 入口不变。
- `POST /v1/inbox-jobs/recover-batch`：**1:1** 收件箱补投任务的原子批量恢复。请求体须为对象且含非空字符串 `device_id` 与非空 `items` 数组；数组项须为对象且仅校验非空字符串 `job_id`、`recovery_id` 两字段，两字段各自不得跨项重复：坏 JSON/体非对象 `400/request_body`，`device_id` 缺失/为空/类型错误 `400/device_id`，`items` 缺失或非非空数组 `400/items`，项非对象 `400/items[i]`，字段缺失/为空/类型错误/重复 `400/items[i].job_id` 或 `400/items[i].recovery_id`。设备未知或已撤销 `409/device_id`（锁内先行）。随后每项沿用 `POST /v1/inbox-jobs` 的 `op=recover` 校验（任务未知 `404`、`job_id` 跨设备或状态不可恢复、`recovery_id` 命名冲突、租约仍有效），错误状态码不变、`field` 改为 `items[i].原field`，按数组序报首错；先全量预检，任一失败全不写。某项的 `recovery_id` 已提交于本任务恢复历史即为重放：全部项均为重放时 `200` 返回各任务当前视图且不写（不落盘、不增 `commit_seq`）；部分项重放 `409`，`field` 为首个重放项的 `items[i].recovery_id`。全部为新恢复时按输入序逐项领取：每项按收件箱既有顺序领取至多 100 条未确认且无有效租约的消息（同批前项新租约立即对后项生效），非空集以该项 `recovery_id` 为**普通**收件箱租约（30 秒、limit=100，可续期/释放/完成）授予、任务保持 `running` 且 `lease_id` 更新为该 id，空集置 `succeeded` 且 `lease_id=null`，均记录一条恢复历史。整批 `201`、与租约/确认/撤销共用存储同一把锁、一次提交且 `commit_seq` 恰加 1；落盘失败 `503/field=data_file` 并全回滚。响应键序 `device_id`、`results`，`results` 保序且项键序 `job_id`、`state`、`lease_id`。新租约此后以 `delivered`/`failed` 完成时同样在同一存储锁事务把对应任务置为 `succeeded`/`failed`。状态文件与 `version=1` 口径同 `POST /v1/inbox-jobs`（不增顶层键，`redelivery_jobs` 项固定五键、空历史写 `[]`，旧四键按 `[]` 加载，矛盾拒启且不覆盖）；错误体键序 `message`、`field`。

lines: - `POST /v1/devices/{device_id}/inbox/leases/{lease_id}/renew`：为 **1:1** 收件箱租约续期 30 秒。请求体须为对象且含非空字符串 `renewal_id`：坏 JSON/体非对象 `400/field=request_body`，`renewal_id` 缺失、为空或类型错误 `400/field=renewal_id`。锁内先判定租约本身：`lease_id` 从未提交 `404/field=lease_id`，租约属于其他设备 `409/field=lease_id`（两者均优先于路径设备状态）。同一租约以相同 `renewal_id` 重放优先判定、恒返回 `200` 及与首次逐字节相同的响应（即便租约此后已到期、已释放或设备已撤销）；`renewal_id` 仅在同一租约内去重，可跨租约复用。仅首次续期继续判定：设备未知或已撤销 `409/field=device_id`，租约已释放或已到期（当前有效截止时间已过）`409/field=lease_id`。首次续期成功 `201`，把租约的有效截止时间（初始领取值，末次续期后为末次续期值）恰延长 30 秒；响应键序固定 `device_id`、`lease_id`、`renewal_id`、`leased_until`，`leased_until` 为新有效截止时间的 UTC ISO-8601（恒为 6 位微秒、`+00:00`）。续期、领取、释放、确认与设备撤销共用存储同一把锁线性化；首次续期一次性提交、`commit_seq` 恰好加 1，落盘失败 `503/field=data_file` 并把内存、状态文件与旁车（含代次、inode）一并回滚；重放不写、不落盘、不增 `commit_seq`。`version=1` 不新增顶层键：`delivery[].leases[]` 元素在原四键（`lease_id`、`limit`、`leased_until`、`released_at`）之后追加 `renewals` 数组，旧文件缺该字段按空加载；数组项键序固定 `renewal_id`、`leased_until`，`renewal_id` 为非空字符串、`leased_until` 为上述 UTC 时间格式；同一租约在各 `delivery` 记录中的副本必须逐项相同，同一租约内 `renewal_id` 不重复，且各项 `leased_until` 必须相对前一有效截止时间（首项相对领取值）逐项恰增 30 秒，类型错误、副本不一致、id 重复或增量不符一律拒绝启动且绝不覆盖原文件；序列化沿用 README 既有口径（UTF-8、`ensure_ascii=false`、紧凑 JSON，元素键序固定）。无新 CLI 子命令；README 既有入口行为不变且不属本题。

- `GET /v1/devices/{device_id}/inbox/leases/{lease_id}`：查询 **1:1** 收件箱租约当前状态。无请求体、无查询参数；非空体 `400/field=request_body`，携带查询参数（含裸 `?foo`；仅末尾空 `?` 不算）`400/field=query`，错误体键序 `message`、`field`。锁内先判定租约本身：`lease_id` 从未提交 `404/field=lease_id`，租约属于其他设备 `409/field=lease_id`（两者均优先于路径设备状态）；匹配即返回，路径设备此后已撤销仍可查（本接口不判定设备状态）。成功 `200`，体键序固定 `device_id`、`lease_id`、`limit`、`state`、`leased_until`、`released_at`、`completion`、`messages`：`limit` 取领取时冻结值；`leased_until` 取当前有效截止（末次续期后的值，无续期取领取值）；`released_at` 为释放时刻 UTC ISO-8601 字符串或 `null`；`completion` 为 `null` 或依次含 `completion_id`、`outcome`、`completed_at` 的对象。`state` 仅 `active`/`expired`/`released`/`completed`：完成、释放优先于到期，未终止且查询时刻早于有效截止才为 `active`，否则 `expired`。`messages` 按领取顺序（收件箱既有 `(session.created_at, session_id 码点序, sequence)` 顺序）列出该租约领取的全部消息，项键序 `session_id`、`message_id`、`sequence`、`acked`、`attempts`，后两项取锁内 `delivery` 记录当前值，确认只置 `acked` 不删项（重试计数照常反映）。查询与领取、续期、释放、完成、确认、重试、设备撤销共用存储同一把锁线性化，但为纯只读：不落盘、不增 `commit_seq`、不改任何游标、租约或计数，状态未变则响应逐字节相同。`version=1` 不新增顶层键或字段（租约及其释放、续期、完成本就持久于 `delivery[].leases`，重启完整恢复，查询结果一致）；无 CLI 子命令；其余 README 入口行为不变、不属本题。

- `GET /v1/devices/{device_id}/inbox/leases`：分页查询 **1:1** 收件箱租约历史。无请求体；非空体 `400/field=request_body`。仅允许单值查询参数 `state`、`after`、`limit`：出现任何其他参数（含裸 `?foo`）`400/field=query`；`state` 默认 `all`，仅可为 `all`/`active`/`expired`/`released`/`completed`，重复或非法值 `400/field=state`；`after` 默认 0，须为无符号十进制整数（仅 ASCII 数字、无符号、无空白/小数点/进制前缀；前导零允许），重复或非法 `400/field=after`；`limit` 默认 100，取值 1..100，同样的严格十进制校验，越界、重复或非法 `400/field=limit`；仅末尾空 `?` 不算参数。错误体键序 `message`、`field`。路径设备未知 `404/field=device_id`，已撤销仍可查。锁内把同一 `lease_id` 跨各消息 `delivery` 记录的副本按 `lease_id` 去重（恢复校验保证各副本一致），仅统计路径设备作为接收方的 1:1 会话；按初始领取 `leased_until`、再按 `lease_id` 码点序排序，依查询时刻的当前状态（完成优先于释放、再为有效/到期，判定与单租约查询一致）过滤，随后跳过前 `after` 项、取至多 `limit` 项。成功 `200`，体键序固定 `device_id`、`leases`、`next_after`、`has_more`；每项键序 `lease_id`、`state`、`leased_until`、`message_count`，`state` 与 `leased_until`（当前有效截止，末次续期后取续期值）沿用单租约查询，`message_count` 为该租约领取的消息数。空页 `next_after=after`，否则为 `after` 加本页返回数；`has_more` 表示过滤后的列表尚有后续项。查询与领取、续期、释放、完成、确认、重试、撤销共用存储同一把锁线性化，但纯只读：不落盘、不增 `commit_seq`、不改任何游标、租约或计数，状态未变则响应逐字节相同。`version=1` 不新增顶层键或字段（租约本就持久于 `delivery[].leases`，重启完整恢复，查询结果一致）；无新状态键或 CLI 子命令；既有 HTTP/CLI、持久化及异常行为均不属本题并保持不变。

-- `POST /v1/inbox-jobs`：**1:1** 收件箱补投任务（queue/dispatch/status/recover 四合一入口）。请求体须为对象且含非空字符串 `device_id`、`job_id`、`op`，`op` 仅可为 `queue`/`dispatch`/`status`/`recover`：坏 JSON/体非对象 `400/request_body`，字段缺失/为空/类型错误 `400`/本字段，`op` 非法 `400/op`。设备未知或已撤销 `409/device_id`（锁内先于任务判定）。`queue` 首次 `201` 建 `pending` 任务；同 `job_id` 同设备重放 `200`（返回当前视图，不写），同 `job_id` 跨设备 `409/job_id`。`dispatch`/`status`/`recover` 对从未入队的 id `404/job_id`；`status` 恒 `200` 只读，`dispatch` 对非 `pending` 任务重放 `200` 且不写。`pending` 任务的首次 `dispatch` 按收件箱既有顺序（`(session.created_at, session_id 码点序, sequence)`）领取至多 100 条未确认且无有效租约的消息，以 `job_id` 作为租约 `lease_id`（租约期限与续期规则同 inbox/claim）：非空领取置 `running` 且 `lease_id` 为该 id，空集置 `succeeded` 且 `lease_id` 为 `null`，均 `201` 并一次性提交（`commit_seq` 恰加 1）。该租约经 `POST …/inbox/leases/{lease_id}/complete` 以 `delivered`/`failed` 完成时，任务在同一存储锁事务内置为 `succeeded`/`failed`。`recover` 为 `running` 任务失效租约的恢复：体须另含非空字符串 `recovery_id`，缺失、为空或类型错误 `400/recovery_id`；设备判定同前（未知/撤销 `409/device_id`）；任务未知 `404/job_id`，`job_id` 属其他设备 `409/job_id`；`recovery_id` 已用于其他任务的恢复历史、等于任一 `job_id`，或已占用为任一收件箱租约 id（含其他恢复产生的租约）均 `409/recovery_id`；同 `recovery_id` 同任务重放优先于状态判定、恒 `200` 返回该任务当前视图且不写（不落盘、不增 `commit_seq`，即便此后任务已终结；设备门与 queue/dispatch/status 一致先行，设备未知或撤销仍 `409/device_id`）。仅当前租约已到期或已 `released` 的 `running` 任务可恢复：当前租约仍有效 `409/lease_id`，`pending`/`succeeded`/`failed` 等其他状态 `409/job_id`。首次恢复锁内按收件箱既有顺序领取至多 100 条「未确认且无有效租约」的消息：非空集以 `recovery_id` 作为**普通**收件箱租约（期限同 inbox/claim 的 30 秒、limit=100，可续期/释放/完成）授予并记录到各消息 `delivery`，任务保持 `running` 且其 `lease_id` 更新为该 `recovery_id`（旧到期/已释放租约保留为历史，不再阻挡领取）；空集置任务 `succeeded` 且 `lease_id=null`；两种结果均 `201`、一次性提交（`commit_seq` 恰加 1），新租约此后以 `delivered`/`failed` 完成时同样在同一存储锁事务把任务置为 `succeeded`/`failed`。响应（四 op 一致）与状态文件 `redelivery_jobs` 项键序固定 `job_id`、`device_id`、`state`、`lease_id`，`lease_id` 为字符串或 `null`。任务与租约领取/续期/释放/完成、确认、撤销共用存储同一把锁提交；落盘失败 `503/field=data_file` 并回滚内存与文件，重放不写、不落盘、不增 `commit_seq`。`version=1` 的 `redelivery_jobs` 段项键序为五键依次 `job_id`、`device_id`、`state`、`lease_id`、`recoveries`；旧项缺末键按空数组加载。`recoveries` 数组按提交序排列，每项仅含 `recovery_id`、`lease_id` 两键（键序如此），`recovery_id` 为非空字符串、`lease_id` 仅为同名字符串（非空恢复）或 `null`（空集终结的恢复）。该段存在时加载校验：`job_id` 唯一、设备已注册、`state` 为四值之一；`recovery_id` 不跨任务恢复历史重复；非空恢复的 `lease_id` 必须指向一条确属本设备的收件箱租约且与 `recovery_id` 同名，恢复记录不得复用本任务的派单租约 id（即 `recovery_id` 不得等于本任务 `job_id`）；空恢复（`lease_id=null`）不建租约，故其 id 之后可被另一任务用作 `job_id`，恢复按状态机一致性接受。状态机与 `delivery[].leases` 双向一致——无恢复记录沿用原规则（`pending` 无租约、`running` 有属本设备且未完成的派单租约、`succeeded` 无租约或派单租约已 `delivered`、`failed` 派单租约已 `failed`），有恢复记录时派单租约（id 为 `job_id`）必须存在、属本设备且从未完成，中间各恢复租约必须未完成（到期或释放），末条非空恢复租约在 `running` 下未完成且为当前 `lease_id`、在 `succeeded`/`failed` 下恰以对应结果完成，末条为空恢复仅允许 `succeeded` 且当前 `lease_id=null`；任何矛盾拒启且绝不覆盖原文件。空 `recoveries` 的项序列化时仍省略末键（旧文档规范快照哈希不变）；序列化沿用既有口径（UTF-8、`ensure_ascii=false`、紧凑无换行）。无新 CLI 子命令；其余 README 入口不变。

class InboxJobPersistenceTest(InboxMixin, unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.directory = tempfile.mkdtemp()
        self._build()
        self.path = os.path.join(self.directory, "state.json")
        self.state_store = attach_persistence(self.service, self.path)

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        shutil.rmtree(self.directory, ignore_errors=True)

    def _job(self, device_id="bob", job_id="j1", op="queue"):
        return self.service.inbox_job(
            {"device_id": device_id, "job_id": job_id, "op": op})

    def test_queue_and_dispatch_each_advance_one_generation(self) -> None:
        before = self.state_store.commit_seq
        self._job()
        self.assertEqual(self.state_store.commit_seq, before + 1)
        self._job(op="dispatch")
        self.assertEqual(self.state_store.commit_seq, before + 2)
        with open(self.path, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            document = json.load(handle)
        self.assertEqual(document["redelivery_jobs"], [
            {"job_id": "j1", "device_id": "bob", "state": "running",
             "lease_id": "j1"}])

    def test_replays_and_status_consume_no_generation(self) -> None:
        self._job()
        self._job(op="dispatch")
        generation = self.state_store.commit_seq
        self._job()                      # queue replay
        self._job(op="dispatch")         # dispatch replay
        self._job(op="status")           # read-only
        self.assertEqual(self.state_store.commit_seq, generation)

    def test_restart_restores_job_states(self) -> None:
        self._job(job_id="j-pending")
        self._job(job_id="j1")
        self._job(job_id="j1", op="dispatch")

        self._job(job_id="j2", op="dispatch")
        self.service.inbox_lease_complete(
            "bob", "j2", {"completion_id": "c2", "outcome": "failed"})
        # bob2's inbox is emptied, so j3 succeeds without a lease.

            for bad in ("", 1, None, True):
                payload = {"device_id": "bob", "job_id": "j1", "op": "queue",
                           field: bad}
                error = self._error(lambda: self.service.inbox_job(payload))
                self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                                 (400, field), (field, bad))
        for bad_op in ("Queue", "run", "queued", ""):
            error = self._error(lambda: self.service.inbox_job(
                {"device_id": "bob", "job_id": "j1", "op": bad_op}))
            self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                             (400, "op"), bad_op)


class InboxJobPersistenceTest(InboxMixin, unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.directory = tempfile.mkdtemp()
        self._build()
        self.path = os.path.join(self.directory, "state.json")
        self.state_store = attach_persistence(self.service, self.path)

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        shutil.rmtree(self.directory, ignore_errors=True)

    def _job(self, device_id="bob", job_id="j1", op="queue"):
        return self.service.inbox_job(
            {"device_id": device_id, "job_id": job_id, "op": op})

    def test_queue_and_dispatch_each_advance_one_generation(self) -> None:
        before = self.state_store.commit_seq
        self._job()
        self.assertEqual(self.state_store.commit_seq, before + 1)
        self._job(op="dispatch")
        self.assertEqual(self.state_store.commit_seq, before + 2)
        with open(self.path, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            document = json.load(handle)
        self.assertEqual(document["redelivery_jobs"], [
            {"job_id": "j1", "device_id": "bob", "state": "running",
             "lease_id": "j1"}])

    def test_replays_and_status_consume_no_generation(self) -> None:
        self._job()
        self._job(op="dispatch")
        generation = self.state_store.commit_seq
        self._job()                      # queue replay
        self._job(op="dispatch")         # dispatch replay
        self._job(op="status")           # read-only
        self.assertEqual(self.state_store.commit_seq, generation)

    def test_restart_restores_job_states(self) -> None:
        self._job(job_id="j-pending")
        self._job(job_id="j1")
        self._job(job_id="j1", op="dispatch")
        self.service.inbox_lease_complete(
            "bob", "j1", {"completion_id": "c1", "outcome": "delivered"})
        self._job(job_id="j2")
        self._job(job_id="j2", op="dispatch")
        self.service.inbox_lease_complete(
            "bob", "j2", {"completion_id": "c2", "outcome": "failed"})
        # bob2's inbox is emptied, so j3 succeeds without a lease.

"""Tests for ``POST /v1/inbox-jobs/recover-batch``.

The batch entry atomically recovers many running redelivery jobs of one
device: every item follows the single-job ``op=recover`` rules (its error
status codes, with the field prefixed to ``items[i].``), all items are
prechecked in array order before anything is claimed, and the whole batch
commits as one generation. A fully replayed batch answers 200 and writes
nothing; a partially replayed one conflicts 409 at its first replayed
item's ``items[i].recovery_id``.
"""
import json
import os
import shutil
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
from http.client import HTTPConnection

from tests.test_device_inbox import InboxMixin
from e2ee_backend.persistence import (
    StateFileError, attach_persistence)
from e2ee_backend.service import DeviceService, ServiceError
from e2ee_backend.http_app import create_server


_PAST = "2000-01-01T00:00:00.000000+00:00"


class RecoverBatchMixin(InboxMixin):
    def _error(self, callable_):
        with self.assertRaises(ServiceError) as caught:
            callable_()
        return caught.exception

    def _job(self, device_id="bob", job_id="j1", op="queue", **extra):
        payload = {"device_id": device_id, "job_id": job_id, "op": op}
        payload.update(extra)
        return self.service.inbox_job(payload)

    def _dispatch(self, job_id="j1", device_id="bob"):
        self._job(device_id=device_id, job_id=job_id)
        return self._job(device_id=device_id, job_id=job_id, op="dispatch")

    def _expire(self, *lease_ids: str) -> None:
        with self.service.store._lock:
            for state in self.service.store._delivery.values():
                for lease in state.leases:
                    if lease.lease_id in lease_ids:
                        lease.leased_until = _PAST

    def _batch(self, items, device_id="bob"):
        return self.service.inbox_job_recover_batch(
            {"device_id": device_id, "items": items})

    @staticmethod
    def _item(job_id, recovery_id):
        return {"job_id": job_id, "recovery_id": recovery_id}


class InboxJobRecoverBatchShapeTest(RecoverBatchMixin, unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self._build()

    def test_body_and_device_id_shape(self) -> None:
        for bad in (None, [], "x", 1, True):
            error = self._error(lambda: self.service.inbox_job_recover_batch(bad))
            self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                             (400, "request_body"), bad)
        for bad in ({}, {"device_id": ""}, {"device_id": 1},
                    {"device_id": None}, {"device_id": True}):
            error = self._error(lambda: self.service.inbox_job_recover_batch(
                dict(bad, items=[self._item("j1", "r1")])
                if bad else bad))
            self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                             (400, "device_id"), bad)

    def test_items_shape(self) -> None:
        for bad in ({}, {"items": None}, {"items": {}}, {"items": "x"},
                    {"items": []}):
            error = self._error(lambda: self.service.inbox_job_recover_batch(
                dict({"device_id": "bob"}, **bad)))
            self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                             (400, "items"), bad)
        for bad in ("x", 1, None, [], True):
            error = self._error(lambda: self._batch([bad]))
            self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                             (400, "items[0]"), bad)

    def test_item_field_shape(self) -> None:
        cases = [
            ({}, "items[0].job_id"),
            ({"recovery_id": "r1"}, "items[0].job_id"),
            ({"job_id": ""}, "items[0].job_id"),
            ({"job_id": 1}, "items[0].job_id"),
            ({"job_id": None}, "items[0].job_id"),
            ({"job_id": True}, "items[0].job_id"),
            ({"job_id": "j1"}, "items[0].recovery_id"),
            ({"job_id": "j1", "recovery_id": ""}, "items[0].recovery_id"),
            ({"job_id": "j1", "recovery_id": 1}, "items[0].recovery_id"),
            ({"job_id": "j1", "recovery_id": None}, "items[0].recovery_id"),
            ({"job_id": "j1", "recovery_id": True}, "items[0].recovery_id"),
        ]
        for item, field in cases:
            error = self._error(lambda: self._batch([item]))
            self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                             (400, field), item)

    def test_item_field_shape_reports_the_first_bad_item(self) -> None:
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch(
            [self._item("j1", "r1"), {"job_id": "j2"},
             {"job_id": "j3", "recovery_id": 4}]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (400, "items[1].recovery_id"))

    def test_duplicate_fields_are_rejected_per_field(self) -> None:
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch(
            [self._item("j1", "r1"), self._item("j1", "r2")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (400, "items[1].job_id"))
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch(
            [self._item("j1", "r1"), self._item("j2", "r1")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (400, "items[1].recovery_id"))
        # The same value may still serve as one item's job_id and another
        # item's recovery_id at the shape level (the store rules apply).
        self._dispatch("j1")
        self._expire("j1")
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch(
            [self._item("j1", "r1"), self._item("r1", "r9")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (404, "items[1].job_id"))


class InboxJobRecoverBatchServiceTest(RecoverBatchMixin, unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self._build()

    def test_device_state_wins_over_item_checks(self) -> None:
        self._dispatch()
        self._expire("j1")
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch(
            [self._item("j1", "r1")], device_id="ghost"))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field), (409, "device_id"))
        self.service.store.revoke_device("bob")
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch([self._item("j1", "r1")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field), (409, "device_id"))

    def test_unknown_and_cross_device_jobs(self) -> None:
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch([self._item("ghost", "r1")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (404, "items[0].job_id"))
        self._dispatch()
        self._expire("j1")
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch(
            [self._item("j1", "r1")], device_id="bob2"))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (409, "items[0].job_id"))

    def test_first_error_in_array_order_is_reported(self) -> None:
        self._dispatch("j1")
        self._expire("j1")
        # Item 0 is valid; item 1's job is unknown; item 2's lease is
        # still valid — the array's first error wins.
        self._dispatch("j3")
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch(
            [self._item("j1", "r1"), self._item("ghost", "r2"),
             self._item("j3", "r3")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (404, "items[1].job_id"))
        # Nothing was written: j1 keeps its dispatch lease and no recovery
        # history, so the same batch fails identically again.
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch(
            [self._item("j1", "r1"), self._item("ghost", "r2")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (404, "items[1].job_id"))
        body, _ = self._job(op="status")
        self.assertEqual(body["lease_id"], "j1")

    def test_recovery_id_conflicts_carry_the_item_path(self) -> None:
        self._dispatch("j1")
        self._expire("j1")
        # The id equals another job's job_id.
        self._job(job_id="j2")
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch([self._item("j1", "j2")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (409, "items[0].recovery_id"))
        # The id is occupied by an unrelated inbox claim lease.
        self.service.inbox_claim("bob", {"lease_id": "L-used", "limit": 1})
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch([self._item("j1", "L-used")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (409, "items[0].recovery_id"))
        # The id is committed on another job's recovery history.
        self._batch([self._item("j1", "r1")])
        self._dispatch("j3")
        self._expire("j3")
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch([self._item("j3", "r1")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (409, "items[0].recovery_id"))

    def test_unrecoverable_states_carry_the_item_path(self) -> None:
        self._dispatch("j1")
        # The dispatch lease is still valid.
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch([self._item("j1", "r1")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (409, "items[0].lease_id"))
        # A pending job cannot be recovered.
        self._job(job_id="jp")
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch([self._item("jp", "rp")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (409, "items[0].job_id"))
        # A terminal job cannot be recovered.
        self._expire("j1")
        self._batch([self._item("j1", "r1")])
        self.service.inbox_lease_complete(
            "bob", "r1", {"completion_id": "c1", "outcome": "delivered"})
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch([self._item("j1", "r2")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (409, "items[0].job_id"))

    def test_batch_recovers_in_input_order_as_one_commit(self) -> None:
        self._dispatch("j1")
        self._dispatch("j2")
        self._expire("j1", "j2")
        body, status = self._batch(
            [self._item("j2", "r2"), self._item("j1", "r1")])
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        self.assertEqual(list(body), ["device_id", "results"])
        self.assertEqual(body["device_id"], "bob")
        self.assertEqual([list(item) for item in body["results"]],
                         [["job_id", "state", "lease_id"]] * 2)
        # Results keep input order; the first item claimed the whole inbox,
        # so the second recovery found an empty selection and succeeded.
        self.assertEqual(body["results"], [
            {"job_id": "j2", "state": "running", "lease_id": "r2"},
            {"job_id": "j1", "state": "succeeded", "lease_id": None},
        ])
        lease = self.service.inbox_lease_get("bob", "r2")
        self.assertEqual(lease["state"], "active")
        self.assertEqual(lease["limit"], 100)
        self.assertEqual([m["message_id"] for m in lease["messages"]],
                         ["a1", "a2", "a3", "b1", "b2"])
        # The reverse input order leases j1 and ends j2 instead.
        self._dispatch("j3")
        self._dispatch("j4")
        self._expire("j3", "j4")
        body, status = self._batch(
            [self._item("j3", "r3"), self._item("j4", "r4")])
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        self.assertEqual(body["results"], [
            {"job_id": "j3", "state": "succeeded", "lease_id": None},
            {"job_id": "j4", "state": "succeeded", "lease_id": None},
        ])

    def test_empty_selection_succeeds_without_lease(self) -> None:
        self._dispatch("j1")
        self._expire("j1")
        self.service.sync_session_ack(
            self.sid1, {"device_id": "bob", "cursor": 3})
        self.service.sync_session_ack(
            self.sid2, {"device_id": "bob", "cursor": 2})
        body, status = self._batch([self._item("j1", "empty")])
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        self.assertEqual(body["results"], [
            {"job_id": "j1", "state": "succeeded", "lease_id": None}])
        error = self._error(
            lambda: self.service.inbox_lease_get("bob", "empty"))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field), (404, "lease_id"))

    def test_full_replay_returns_current_views_without_writing(self) -> None:
        self._dispatch("j1")
        self._dispatch("j2")
        self._expire("j1", "j2")
        first, status = self._batch(
            [self._item("j1", "r1"), self._item("j2", "r2")])
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        # The identical batch replays byte-identically with 200.
        replay, status = self._batch(
            [self._item("j1", "r1"), self._item("j2", "r2")])
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(replay, first)
        # A replay after the jobs terminated returns the current views.
        self.service.inbox_lease_complete(
            "bob", "r1", {"completion_id": "c1", "outcome": "failed"})
        replay, status = self._batch(
            [self._item("j1", "r1"), self._item("j2", "r2")])
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(replay["results"][0],
                         {"job_id": "j1", "state": "failed",
                          "lease_id": "r1"})
        # The device gate still precedes the replay decision.
        self.service.store.revoke_device("bob")
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch(
            [self._item("j1", "r1"), self._item("j2", "r2")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field), (409, "device_id"))

    def test_partial_replay_conflicts_at_the_first_replayed_item(self) -> None:
        self._dispatch("j1")
        self._dispatch("j2")
        self._expire("j1", "j2")
        self._batch([self._item("j1", "r1"), self._item("j2", "r2")])
        self._expire("r2")
        # Item 0 is a replay, item 1 is fresh: the batch was partially
        # applied before and cannot be reproduced atomically.
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch(
            [self._item("j1", "r1"), self._item("j2", "r3")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (409, "items[0].recovery_id"))
        # The first replayed item is reported, not a later one.
        self._expire("r1")
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch(
            [self._item("j1", "r9"), self._item("j2", "r2")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),

"""Tests for ``POST /v1/inbox-jobs/recover-batch``.

The batch entry atomically recovers many running redelivery jobs of one
device: every item follows the single-job ``op=recover`` rules (its error
status codes, with the field prefixed to ``items[i].``), all items are
prechecked in array order before anything is claimed, and the whole batch
commits as one generation. A fully replayed batch answers 200 and writes
nothing; a partially replayed one conflicts 409 at its first replayed
item's ``items[i].recovery_id``.
"""
import json
import os
import shutil
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
from http.client import HTTPConnection

from tests.test_device_inbox import InboxMixin
from e2ee_backend.persistence import (
    StateFileError, attach_persistence)
from e2ee_backend.service import DeviceService, ServiceError
from e2ee_backend.http_app import create_server


_PAST = "2000-01-01T00:00:00.000000+00:00"


class RecoverBatchMixin(InboxMixin):
    def _error(self, callable_):
        with self.assertRaises(ServiceError) as caught:
            callable_()
        return caught.exception

    def _job(self, device_id="bob", job_id="j1", op="queue", **extra):
        payload = {"device_id": device_id, "job_id": job_id, "op": op}
        payload.update(extra)
        return self.service.inbox_job(payload)

    def _dispatch(self, job_id="j1", device_id="bob"):
        self._job(device_id=device_id, job_id=job_id)
        return self._job(device_id=device_id, job_id=job_id, op="dispatch")

    def _expire(self, *lease_ids: str) -> None:
        with self.service.store._lock:
            for state in self.service.store._delivery.values():
                for lease in state.leases:
                    if lease.lease_id in lease_ids:
                        lease.leased_until = _PAST

    def _batch(self, items, device_id="bob"):
        return self.service.inbox_job_recover_batch(
            {"device_id": device_id, "items": items})

    @staticmethod
    def _item(job_id, recovery_id):
        return {"job_id": job_id, "recovery_id": recovery_id}

    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.directory = tempfile.mkdtemp()
        self._build()

    def test_batch_advances_one_generation_replay_none(self) -> None:

        _, status = self._batch([self._item("j1", "r1"),

        self.assertEqual(self.state_store.commit_seq, before + 1)

        for job_id, recovery_id in (("j1", "r1"), ("j2", "r2")):
            item = items[job_id]
            self.assertEqual(list(item), ["job_id", "device_id", "state",

        self._dispatch("j1")

    def test_save_failure_rolls_back_the_whole_batch(self) -> None:
        import e2ee_backend.persistence as persistence_mod
        from e2ee_backend.persistence import PersistenceUnavailable

        real_fsync = persistence_mod.os.fsync
        calls = {"n": 0}

        def fail_first_directory_fsync(fd: int) -> None:  # noqa: ANN001
            if os.fstat(fd).st_mode & 0o170000 == 0o040000:
                calls["n"] += 1
                if calls["n"] == 1:
                    raise OSError("transient directory fsync failure")
            real_fsync(fd)

        self._dispatch("j1")
        self._dispatch("j2")
        self._expire("j1", "j2")
        generation = self.state_store.commit_seq
        persistence_mod.os.fsync = fail_first_directory_fsync
        try:
            with self.assertRaises(PersistenceUnavailable):
                self._batch([self._item("j1", "r1"), self._item("j2", "r2")])
        finally:
            persistence_mod.os.fsync = real_fsync
        self.assertEqual(self.state_store.commit_seq, generation)

        # and no recovery history or lease was committed. Memory was
        # rolled back from the on-disk state, which also discards the
        # in-memory expiry hack, so expire again before retrying.
        for job_id in ("j1", "j2"):
            body, status = self._job(job_id=job_id, op="status")
            self.assertEqual((body["state"], body["lease_id"]),
                             ("running", job_id))
        self._expire("j1", "j2")
        body, status = self._batch([self._item("j1", "r1"),
                                    self._item("j2", "r2")])
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        self.assertEqual(self.state_store.commit_seq, generation + 1)

"""Tests for ``POST /v1/inbox-jobs/recover-batch``.

The batch entry atomically recovers many running redelivery jobs of one
device: every item follows the single-job ``op=recover`` rules (its error
status codes, with the field prefixed to ``items[i].``), all items are
prechecked in array order before anything is claimed, and the whole batch
commits as one generation. A fully replayed batch answers 200 and writes
nothing; a partially replayed one conflicts 409 at its first replayed
item's ``items[i].recovery_id``.
"""
import json
import os
import shutil
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
from http.client import HTTPConnection

from tests.test_device_inbox import InboxMixin
from e2ee_backend.persistence import attach_persistence
from e2ee_backend.service import DeviceService, ServiceError
from e2ee_backend.http_app import create_server


_PAST = "2000-01-01T00:00:00.000000+00:00"


class RecoverBatchMixin(InboxMixin):
    def _error(self, callable_):
        with self.assertRaises(ServiceError) as caught:
            callable_()
        return caught.exception

    def _job(self, device_id="bob", job_id="j1", op="queue", **extra):
        payload = {"device_id": device_id, "job_id": job_id, "op": op}
        payload.update(extra)
        return self.service.inbox_job(payload)

    def _dispatch(self, job_id="j1", device_id="bob"):
        self._job(device_id=device_id, job_id=job_id)
        return self._job(device_id=device_id, job_id=job_id, op="dispatch")

    def _post_extra(self) -> None:
        # One more unacked message to bob (sid1's stream continues at 4),
        # so a further dispatch has something to lease while earlier
        # leases are still valid.
        sequence = getattr(self, "_extra_sequence", 4)
        self._extra_sequence = sequence + 1
        self.service.post_message({
            "session_id": self.sid1, "sender_device_id": "alice",
            "message_id": f"x{sequence}", "sequence": sequence,
            "nonce": f"nx{sequence}", "ciphertext": "ct"})

    def _expire(self, *lease_ids: str) -> None:
        with self.service.store._lock:
            for state in self.service.store._delivery.values():
                for lease in state.leases:
                    if lease.lease_id in lease_ids:
                        lease.leased_until = _PAST

    def _batch(self, items, device_id="bob"):
        return self.service.inbox_job_recover_batch(
            {"device_id": device_id, "items": items})

    @staticmethod
    def _item(job_id, recovery_id):
        return {"job_id": job_id, "recovery_id": recovery_id}


class InboxJobRecoverBatchShapeTest(RecoverBatchMixin, unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self._build()

    def test_body_and_device_id_shape(self) -> None:
        for bad in (None, [], "x", 1, True):
            error = self._error(
                lambda: self.service.inbox_job_recover_batch(bad))
            self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                             (400, "request_body"), bad)
        for bad in ({}, {"device_id": ""}, {"device_id": 1},
                    {"device_id": None}, {"device_id": True}):
            error = self._error(
                lambda: self.service.inbox_job_recover_batch(bad))
            self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                             (400, "device_id"), bad)

    def test_items_shape(self) -> None:
        for bad in ({}, {"items": None}, {"items": {}}, {"items": "x"},
                    {"items": []}):
            error = self._error(lambda: self.service.inbox_job_recover_batch(
                dict({"device_id": "bob"}, **bad)))
            self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                             (400, "items"), bad)
        for bad in ("x", 1, None, [], True):
            error = self._error(lambda: self._batch([bad]))
            self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                             (400, "items[0]"), bad)

    def test_item_field_shape(self) -> None:
        cases = [
            ({}, "items[0].job_id"),
            ({"recovery_id": "r1"}, "items[0].job_id"),
            ({"job_id": ""}, "items[0].job_id"),
            ({"job_id": 1}, "items[0].job_id"),
            ({"job_id": None}, "items[0].job_id"),
            ({"job_id": True}, "items[0].job_id"),
            ({"job_id": "j1"}, "items[0].recovery_id"),
            ({"job_id": "j1", "recovery_id": ""}, "items[0].recovery_id"),
            ({"job_id": "j1", "recovery_id": 1}, "items[0].recovery_id"),
            ({"job_id": "j1", "recovery_id": None}, "items[0].recovery_id"),
            ({"job_id": "j1", "recovery_id": True}, "items[0].recovery_id"),
        ]
        for item, field in cases:
            error = self._error(lambda: self._batch([item]))
            self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                             (400, field), item)

    def test_item_field_shape_reports_the_first_bad_item(self) -> None:
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch(
            [self._item("j1", "r1"), {"job_id": "j2"},
             {"job_id": "j3", "recovery_id": 4}]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (400, "items[1].recovery_id"))

    def test_duplicate_fields_are_rejected_per_field(self) -> None:
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch(
            [self._item("j1", "r1"), self._item("j1", "r2")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (400, "items[1].job_id"))
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch(
            [self._item("j1", "r1"), self._item("j2", "r1")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (400, "items[1].recovery_id"))
        # One item's job_id may equal another item's recovery_id at the
        # shape level; the store's own rules reject the unknown job.
        self._dispatch("j1")
        self._expire("j1")
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch(
            [self._item("j1", "r1"), self._item("r1", "r9")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (404, "items[1].job_id"))


class InboxJobRecoverBatchServiceTest(RecoverBatchMixin, unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self._build()

    def test_device_state_wins_over_item_checks(self) -> None:
        self._dispatch()
        self._expire("j1")
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch(
            [self._item("j1", "r1")], device_id="ghost"))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (409, "device_id"))
        self.service.store.revoke_device("bob")
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch([self._item("j1", "r1")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (409, "device_id"))

    def test_unknown_and_cross_device_jobs(self) -> None:
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch([self._item("ghost", "r1")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (404, "items[0].job_id"))
        self._dispatch()
        self._expire("j1")
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch(
            [self._item("j1", "r1")], device_id="bob2"))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (409, "items[0].job_id"))

    def test_first_error_in_array_order_is_reported(self) -> None:
        self._dispatch("j1")
        self._expire("j1")
        self._dispatch("j3")  # takes over the expired selection
        # Item 0 is valid; item 1's job is unknown; item 2's lease is
        # still valid — the array's first error wins.
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch(
            [self._item("j1", "r1"), self._item("ghost", "r2"),
             self._item("j3", "r3")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (404, "items[1].job_id"))
        # Nothing was written: j1 keeps its dispatch lease and no recovery
        # history, so the same batch fails identically again.
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch(
            [self._item("j1", "r1"), self._item("ghost", "r2")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (404, "items[1].job_id"))
        body, _ = self._job(op="status")
        self.assertEqual(body["lease_id"], "j1")

    def test_recovery_id_conflicts_carry_the_item_path(self) -> None:
        self._dispatch("j1")
        self._expire("j1")
        # The id equals another job's job_id.
        self._job(job_id="j2")
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch([self._item("j1", "j2")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (409, "items[0].recovery_id"))
        # The id is occupied by an unrelated inbox claim lease.
        self.service.inbox_claim("bob", {"lease_id": "L-used", "limit": 1})
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch([self._item("j1", "L-used")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (409, "items[0].recovery_id"))
        # The id is committed on another job's recovery history.
        self._batch([self._item("j1", "r1")])
        self._post_extra()
        self._dispatch("j3")
        self._expire("j3")
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch([self._item("j3", "r1")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (409, "items[0].recovery_id"))

    def test_unrecoverable_states_carry_the_item_path(self) -> None:
        self._dispatch("j1")
        # The dispatch lease is still valid.
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch([self._item("j1", "r1")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (409, "items[0].lease_id"))
        # A pending job cannot be recovered.
        self._job(job_id="jp")
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch([self._item("jp", "rp")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (409, "items[0].job_id"))
        # A terminal job cannot be recovered.
        self._expire("j1")
        self._batch([self._item("j1", "r1")])
        self.service.inbox_lease_complete(
            "bob", "r1", {"completion_id": "c1", "outcome": "delivered"})
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch([self._item("j1", "r2")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (409, "items[0].job_id"))

    def test_batch_recovers_in_input_order_as_one_commit(self) -> None:
        self._dispatch("j1")          # leases a1..a3, b1..b2
        self._post_extra()            # x4 stays unleased
        self._dispatch("j2")          # leases x4
        self._expire("j1", "j2")
        body, status = self._batch(
            [self._item("j2", "r2"), self._item("j1", "r1")])
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)

        # Results keep input order: the first item's recovery claimed the

        self.assertEqual(body["results"], [

        self.assertEqual(lease["limit"], 100)
        self.assertEqual([m["message_id"] for m in lease["messages"]],

    def test_empty_selection_succeeds_without_lease(self) -> None:

        self._expire("j1")

        # j1's recovery claimed everything; j2's found an empty inbox.
        self.assertEqual(first["results"], [
            {"job_id": "j1", "state": "running", "lease_id": "r1"},

        # The identical batch replays byte-identically with 200.

"""Tests for ``POST /v1/inbox-jobs/recover-batch``.

The batch entry atomically recovers many running redelivery jobs of one
device: every item follows the single-job ``op=recover`` rules (its error
status codes, with the field prefixed to ``items[i].``), all items are
prechecked in array order before anything is claimed, and the whole batch
commits as one generation. A fully replayed batch answers 200 and writes
nothing; a partially replayed one conflicts 409 at its first replayed
item's ``items[i].recovery_id``.
"""
import json
import os
import shutil
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
from http.client import HTTPConnection

from tests.test_device_inbox import InboxMixin
from e2ee_backend.persistence import attach_persistence
from e2ee_backend.service import DeviceService, ServiceError
from e2ee_backend.http_app import create_server


_PAST = "2000-01-01T00:00:00.000000+00:00"


class RecoverBatchMixin(InboxMixin):
    def _error(self, callable_):
        with self.assertRaises(ServiceError) as caught:
            callable_()
        return caught.exception

    def _job(self, device_id="bob", job_id="j1", op="queue", **extra):
        payload = {"device_id": device_id, "job_id": job_id, "op": op}
        payload.update(extra)
        return self.service.inbox_job(payload)

    def _dispatch(self, job_id="j1", device_id="bob"):
        self._job(device_id=device_id, job_id=job_id)
        return self._job(device_id=device_id, job_id=job_id, op="dispatch")

    def _post_extra(self) -> None:
        # One more unacked message to bob (sid1's stream continues at 4),
        # so a further dispatch has something to lease while earlier
        # leases are still valid.
        sequence = getattr(self, "_extra_sequence", 4)
        self._extra_sequence = sequence + 1
        self.service.post_message({
            "session_id": self.sid1, "sender_device_id": "alice",
            "message_id": f"x{sequence}", "sequence": sequence,
            "nonce": f"nx{sequence}", "ciphertext": "ct"})

    def _expire(self, *lease_ids: str) -> None:
        with self.service.store._lock:
            for state in self.service.store._delivery.values():
                for lease in state.leases:
                    if lease.lease_id in lease_ids:
                        lease.leased_until = _PAST

    def _batch(self, items, device_id="bob"):
        return self.service.inbox_job_recover_batch(
            {"device_id": device_id, "items": items})

    @staticmethod
    def _item(job_id, recovery_id):
        return {"job_id": job_id, "recovery_id": recovery_id}


class InboxJobRecoverBatchShapeTest(RecoverBatchMixin, unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self._build()

    def test_body_and_device_id_shape(self) -> None:
        for bad in (None, [], "x", 1, True):
            error = self._error(
                lambda: self.service.inbox_job_recover_batch(bad))
            self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                             (400, "request_body"), bad)
        for bad in ({}, {"device_id": ""}, {"device_id": 1},
                    {"device_id": None}, {"device_id": True}):
            error = self._error(
                lambda: self.service.inbox_job_recover_batch(bad))
            self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                             (400, "device_id"), bad)

        for bad in ({}, {"items": None}, {"items": {}}, {"items": "x"},
                    {"items": []}):

                dict({"device_id": "bob"}, **bad)))
            self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                             (400, "items"), bad)
        for bad in ("x", 1, None, [], True):
            error = self._error(lambda: self._batch([bad]))
            self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                             (400, "items[0]"), bad)

        cases = [
            ({}, "items[0].job_id"),
            ({"recovery_id": "r1"}, "items[0].job_id"),

            ({"job_id": 1}, "items[0].job_id"),
            ({"job_id": None}, "items[0].job_id"),
            ({"job_id": True}, "items[0].job_id"),
            ({"job_id": "j1"}, "items[0].recovery_id"),
            ({"job_id": "j1", "recovery_id": ""}, "items[0].recovery_id"),
            ({"job_id": "j1", "recovery_id": 1}, "items[0].recovery_id"),
            ({"job_id": "j1", "recovery_id": None}, "items[0].recovery_id"),
            ({"job_id": "j1", "recovery_id": True}, "items[0].recovery_id"),
        ]
        for item, field in cases:
            error = self._error(lambda: self._batch([item]))
            self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                             (400, field), item)

    def test_item_field_shape_reports_the_first_bad_item(self) -> None:
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch(
            [self._item("j1", "r1"), {"job_id": "j2"},
             {"job_id": "j3", "recovery_id": 4}]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (400, "items[1].recovery_id"))

    def test_duplicate_fields_are_rejected_per_field(self) -> None:
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch(
            [self._item("j1", "r1"), self._item("j1", "r2")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (400, "items[1].job_id"))
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch(

        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (400, "items[1].recovery_id"))
        # One item's job_id may equal another item's recovery_id at the
        # shape level; the store's own rules reject the unknown job.
        self._dispatch("j1")
        self._expire("j1")
        error = self._error(lambda: self._batch(
            [self._item("j1", "r1"), self._item("r1", "r9")]))
        self.assertEqual((error.status_code, error.field),
                         (404, "items[1].job_id"))

        self.assertEqual(status, 201)

        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever,
                                       daemon=True)
        self.thread.start()
        self._dispatch("j1")          # leases a1..a3, b1..b2
        self._post_extra()            # x4 stays unleased
        self._dispatch("j2")          # leases x4
        self._expire("j1", "j2")

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        self.server.shutdown()
        self.server.server_close()
        self.thread.join(timeout=2)

    def _request(self, payload):
        conn = HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", self.port, timeout=5)
        conn.request("POST", "/v1/inbox-jobs/recover-batch",
                     body=json.dumps(payload),
                     headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
        response = conn.getresponse()
        data = response.read().decode("utf-8")
        conn.close()
        return response.status, (json.loads(data) if data else None), data

    def test_recover_batch_over_http(self) -> None:
        payload = {"device_id": "bob", "items": [
            {"job_id": "j1", "recovery_id": "r1"},
            {"job_id": "j2", "recovery_id": "r2"}]}
        status, body, raw = self._request(payload)
        self.assertEqual(status, 201)
        self.assertEqual(body, {"device_id": "bob", "results": [
            {"job_id": "j1", "state": "running", "lease_id": "r1"},
            {"job_id": "j2", "state": "succeeded", "lease_id": None}]})
        self.assertLess(raw.index('"device_id"'), raw.index('"results"'))
        item = raw[raw.index('"results"'):]
        self.assertLess(item.index('"job_id"'), item.index('"state"'))
        self.assertLess(item.index('"state"'), item.index('"lease_id"'))
        status, body, _ = self._request(payload)
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(body["results"][0]["lease_id"], "r1")

    def test_errors_over_http(self) -> None:
        status, body, raw = self._request({"device_id": "bob", "items": [
            {"job_id": "ghost", "recovery_id": "r9"}]})
        self.assertEqual(status, 404)
        self.assertEqual(body["field"], "items[0].job_id")
        self.assertLess(raw.index('"message"'), raw.index('"field"'))
        status, body, _ = self._request({"device_id": "ghost", "items": [
            {"job_id": "j1", "recovery_id": "r9"}]})
        self.assertEqual(status, 409)
        self.assertEqual(body["field"], "device_id")
        status, body, _ = self._request({"device_id": "bob", "items": [
            {"job_id": "j1", "recovery_id": "r1"},
            {"job_id": "j2", "recovery_id": "r1"}]})
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)
        self.assertEqual(body["field"], "items[1].recovery_id")
        # A first batch commits; replaying it with one item changed is a

        status, _, _ = self._request({"device_id": "bob", "items": [

            {"job_id": "j1", "recovery_id": "r1"},
            {"job_id": "j2", "recovery_id": "r2"}]})
        self.assertEqual(status, 409)
        self.assertEqual(body["field"], "items[0].recovery_id")
